statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-7631 concerns path traversal through the lng and ns parameters of the locale resource handler. The shipped handler rejects parameters containing path separators or '..' with HTTP 400 before constructing a filesystem or plugin-service path, preventing requests from escaping the intended locale resource. Valid locale requests continue to return HTTP 200; raw and URL-encoded traversal requests are rejected. See https://github.com/openshift/console/blob/ede62388305c8d4cfb3d722e66a1198bebc6f87b/pkg/plugins/handlers.go

CVE-2024-6508 is insufficient entropy in the OAuth2 login state parameter, which weakened the CSRF protection of the authorization flow. The shipped bridge generates the state from 16 bytes (128 bits) of crypto/rand read via io.ReadFull and hex-encodes it (pkg/auth/oauth2 LoginFunc), so the low-entropy implementation the advisory describes is not present.

CVE-2024-6538 concerns the unrestricted /api/dev-console/proxy/internet relay. The shipped bridge's dev-console dispatcher registers only artifacthub, tekton-results, and webhooks route groups; the proxy/internet route is absent and returns HTTP 404 instead of making an outbound request. See https://github.com/openshift/console/blob/ede62388305c8d4cfb3d722e66a1198bebc6f87b/pkg/devconsole/handler.go
